name: CROSSING_ARROWS_YELLOWGREEN_WIDE
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the edge strip (ground colour) and edge + black border, as the AS 1743 drawings. Sheet W8-SA23: W8-SA23B 750 x 250 illustrated (A 600 x 200, C 900 x 300; PNG W8-SA23A.png), fluorescent yellow-green, R50, 10 / 30. Double-headed arrow 500 long (125/500/125), centred (125 above and below its centre line); arrow detail: heads 138 long x 150 wide, shaft 44, notch 14, R5 (typ) — the AS 1743 W8-23 arrow on FYG. For use only with W6-SA110.
